**Dynasty:** 姚秦
**Date:** 405
**Juans:** 3

## Contributors
- 鳩摩羅什 (A001583)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T653 (three fascicles, alt. title 選擇諸法經; Sanskrit *Buddhapiṭakaduḥśīlanirgraha-sūtra*, "Sūtra on the Removal of the Immoral from the Buddha-Basket") is one of [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80)'s most stylistically polished Mahāyāna translations. It is a polemical *prajñāpāramitā*-style critique of corrupt or hypocritical monks, framed as a discourse by the Buddha to [Śāriputra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%88%8D%E5%88%A9%E5%BC%97); the "Buddha-Treasury" of the title is the *prajñāpāramitā* itself, from which the lax monastic must be excluded.

**Abstract**

T653 is unanimously ascribed to [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) in the canonical bibliographies; the *[Chū sānzàng jì jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084)* (T2145, juan 2) and the *[Lìdài sānbǎo jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0011)* (T2034, juan 8) place it among his Cháng'ān works. Date bracket: 401–413. The Sanskrit *Buddhapiṭakaduḥśīlanirgraha* is preserved in Tibetan translation, edited by Padmanabh Jaini and others. The text is an unusually direct Mahāyāna critique of monastic laxity: Śāriputra is told that the *prajñāpāramitā* will soon enter a period of decline in which monks claiming to be bodhisattvas will in fact be hypocrites, and the Buddha lays out criteria for distinguishing the true bodhisattva from the false. The text was a major source for the Chinese Buddhist polemical tradition (cf. the *[Dà zhìdù lùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0005)*) and is cited in disputes over the bodhisattva *vinaya* through the Tang.
